evals.prompt: I'm documenting our deployment pipeline. Make me a drawio flowchart with a Start terminator, a 'Run tests' process, a 'Tests pass?' decision branching Yes to a 'Deploy to prod' process and No back to a 'Notify team' step, ending at a terminator. Save it so I can open it in draw.io and tweak it.
evals.expected_output: A valid .drawio file using flowchart-library shapes (terminator, process, decision) with labeled Yes/No edges, opens in Draw.io.

evals.prompt: Turn this org structure into a tree diagram as a .drawio file: CEO over a CTO and a CFO; CTO over 'Platform' and 'Mobile'; CFO over 'Accounting'. Color it by depth.
evals.expected_output: A TreeDiagram built (ideally from_dict) with depth coloring, auto-laid-out, written to .drawio.

evals.prompt: I need a quick bar chart of quarterly signups (Q1 1200, Q2 1900, Q3 1500, Q4 2400) with a title and a y-axis, exported as a draw.io file I can drop into a deck.
evals.expected_output: A BarChart with show_axis and title, added to a page, written to .drawio.
